title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（佐野渉二研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sano Shoji)
educationalGoal:
Students will
(1) Conduct research activities related to an information technology system for an academically unsolved problem based on their acquired knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology.
(2) Through these activities, students will develop skills related to problem setting, development, presentation, and writing.
advice:
This is the constructive computer science activity. We will cover the following themes:

1. Computer interaction
2. Real-world computing
3. Wearable computing
4. Ubiquitous computing
5. Entertainment computing
6. Public transportation systems
requiredKnowledge: Problem-solving skills learned in this course include planning skills, execution skills, communication skills, programming skills, writing skills, and presentation skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set a project schedule based on a set research topic goal.
Be able to set an appropriate approach or method for the project.
Be able to acquire the IT knowledge and skills needed for proceeding with the project.
Be able to deal with the problems that will occur in the analysis and design process.
Be able to evaluate the result from subjective and objective viewpoints for better understanding.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students conduct research activities related to problem setting, design, and implementation of an information system. They then write a project report and make a conference level presentation.
achievementLevels.standard: Students conduct a set of research activities related to problem setting, design, and implementation of an information system. They then write a project report and make a presentation.
